result.title: SailSearch: Agent-Assisted Discovery in Combinatorial Optimization
result.summary: We present SailSearch, a human-guided workflow for algorithmic research with two language-model agents, and report results on Market Split and maximum independent set (MIS). For Market Split, our randomized algorithm searches across multiple lattice bases, dividing computation between enumeration and continued basis reduction. Across ten random seeds per instance, it found the first reported CPU-only solutions to 18 of 33 previously open QOBLIB instances, solving 130 to 133 of the 156 benchmark instances per seed with a 24-hour cutoff on two CPU cores. For MIS, our generator encodes planted XOR constraints as graphs with certified optima; on seven instances with 1,752 to 3,996 vertices, the best solutions returned by the tested solvers in eight-hour runs were 5 to 15 vertices below the optimum.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 SailSearch：一个由人类指导、两个语言模型 agent 协作的算法研究流程，并在 Market Split（多格基随机化枚举与约化）与 MIS（带可证最优的 XOR 约束图生成）上报告求解结果。
AI.relevance_reason: 研究对象是组合优化算法发现与基准求解，未涉及视觉或多模态信息、latent 推理状态及其使用与评价，LLM agent 仅充当算法研究工作流助手，与 LVR 的表示、生成与停止决策问题缺少可核查的具体线索。
